rationale: iter-60: switch SWA from per-epoch (6 snapshots) to per-step (~2400 samples) on NAFNet+3BF+wd=1e-4. Headroom 0.5821 (iter-59) -> 0.5853 (+0.32pp). The SWA implementation detail matters substantially: per-step gives much more averaging, smoother weights. Still 1.35pp below Agent A iter-38 (0.5988) — remaining gap is ReLU vs GELU gate + possibly epochs=8 vs Agent As 6.
advice_for_others: SWA per-step vs per-epoch is +0.3pp on NAFNet+BF substrates. The choice matters. Use vectorised per-step accumulation (torch._foreach_*) for fast-converging components like Wagner BF sigmas.
